subject: Change order request: split SOW deliverables and invoice routing
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@healthline.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procure+contracts@healthline.ai
Date: 2028-06-09T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Change order request: split SOW deliverables and invoice routing

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. After internal alignment, we would like to proceed with a narrow change order rather than a full amendment. High level:
- Split Exhibit C (Implementation SOW) into two line items: 
  1) Core inference integration (fixed-fee)
  2) Ops & monitoring retainer (monthly)
- Reallocate fees so the fixed-fee covers initial integration milestones and the monthly covers post-go-live alerting/ops.
- Request that the invoicing path for the monthly retainer be to billing@healthline.ai and that invoices are net-30.

Can you confirm your willingness to: (a) produce a redline of the order form/Exhibit C that implements this split, and (b) provide a proposed invoice schedule and proration approach for mid-month activations? We can share a short doc that maps milestones if that helps.

Attaching a short internal note for context (SOW-exhibit-C-diff.txt). We prefer a single change order (not MSA rewrite) if possible.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement
Healthline AI

Attachments: SOW-exhibit-C-diff.txt (text)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@healthline.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Change order request: split SOW deliverables and invoice routing

Elena —

Thanks for the clear note and the diff. We can absolutely do a single change order to re-surface Exhibit C into two billing line items. Next steps I propose:

1) Connor (legal) to produce a redlined order form that:
   - splits Exhibit C into two line items with clear acceptance criteria per milestone,
   - preserves existing MSA terms, and
   - adds language for monthly retainer invoicing and allocation.
2) Laura (revops) to propose an invoice schedule and proration table for mid-month activations, and confirm net-30 billing routing.
3) I will schedule a 30-min sync for Tuesday to confirm approach with your team and walk through the proposed payment table.

Can you confirm: preferred start date for the retainer (1st of month vs immediate prorate), and whether Healthline needs separate EDI/billing identifiers on the CO? If you send the milestone mapping doc that will speed things up.

We'll attach the redline in docx and a shorter HTML summary for your finance team.

-k

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0113

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Elena Morales <elena.morales@healthline.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-10T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Change order request: split SOW deliverables and invoice routing

Elena / team —

Attached is a draft redline (Healthline_CO_v3_redlines.docx) that implements the Exhibit C split and includes a short clause for monthly retainer billing and proration. Key legal notes up front:
- We preserve the MSA's liability and data terms. This CO only reclassifies scope and fee schedule.
- Suggested language for proration (if retainer begins mid-month): prorate on a per-day basis for that first invoice.
- For the fixed-fee integration, we kept 3 milestones (Kickoff, Integration Complete, Acceptance) with acceptance testing window of 10 business days.
- If Healthline requires separate billing identifiers (PO/EDI), we will append an invoice header field and ship invoices to billing@healthline.ai as requested; please provide the PO number when available.

Open items I want to confirm with you both:
1) Do you want the ops retainer to be invoiced in advance (monthly advance) or in arrears? We typically do advance for retainers but can accommodate arrears if preferred.
2) Any tax withholding or local invoicing nuances we should be aware of for your AP process?

If that looks good, I'll move the doc to a 'final for signature' version and Kimberly can circulate the DocuSign link.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

Attachments: Healthline_CO_v3_redlines.docx (document)
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@healthline.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procure+contracts@healthline.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Change order request: split SOW deliverables and invoice routing

Thanks Connor / Kimberly — this is great and aligns with our expectations. A few quick answers:
- Retainer: invoice in advance on the 1st of each month is preferred.
- Proration: per-day proration for the first partial month is fine.
- Billing identifiers: our AP team will provide a PO within 3 business days; billing should go to billing@healthline.ai.

We are ready for the DocuSign link once you convert the redline to a final CO. Can you include a one-paragraph summary for our CFO (just the fee split and monthly net-30 terms)? That will speed internal sign-off.

Elena
